note: The owner, 2026-09-25: the Rift's weather should be thunder permanently, with no rain if possible. Minecraft weather is one state for the whole dimension, so a real thunderstorm here would be a storm over the whole map. What is the Rift's alone: its biome (cobblers:the_rift, data/rift_skin.json) already has no precipitation, so it never rains inside the lip even when the world does, and its sky and fog are dark. This file adds the storm: thunder heard only by players standing in the Rift, and lightning striking the Rift's bare rock at a distance from them. Generated by tools/rift_storm.py into a world pack that runs itself. Cobblemon spawns conditioned on real thunder (isThundering) do not see this storm.

per_check_percent.why: checked once a second per player in the Rift: a strike about every 33 seconds and a distant rumble without a bolt about every 25

strike.ground_why: a bolt lights a fire where it lands; it only lands on bare rock, where the fire has nothing to take and goes out
strike.no_strike_why: no bolt within 32 blocks of a place built in the Rift: its timber, tents and people
